extracted.intended_audience: adult learners and prospective students interested in Stanford Continuing Studies creative writing courses
extracted.subtask_description: Selecting and enrolling in Stanford Continuing Studies creative writing courses (online or on-campus) across genres and skill levels. The page describes program features, course types, instructor credentials, and registration guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expert instruction
rubrics_metrics.description: Most of the instructors in our program have established careers as novelists, journalists, playwrights, and screenwriters. Many have served as fellows in Stanford’s prestigious Stegner Creative Writing Program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates instructor qualifications and professional experience as a marker of course quality; use instructor credentials when evaluating a course's instructional strength.

rubrics_metrics.name: Individual attention
rubrics_metrics.description: Our on-campus and online writing courses offer ... individual attention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course formats and class sizes that provide one-on-one or small-group attention are a stated program feature; prospective students should prefer offerings that promise individualized feedback and mentoring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supportive feedback at all levels
rubrics_metrics.description: Offer expert instruction, individual attention, and supportive feedback at all levels, in all genres of creative writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supportive, constructive feedback is emphasized as part of the learning environment; this is a quality criterion for workshops and critiques across beginner to advanced courses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Courses for all skill levels
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether you’re just beginning to write or putting the finishing touches on your first novel, our ... courses offer ... individual attention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program serves beginners through advanced writers; choose courses that match current skill level and goals (e.g., foundational practice vs. manuscript completion).

rubrics_metrics.name: Variety of genres offered
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose from writing courses in creative nonfiction, fiction, poetry, memoir, magazine writing, travel writing, the short story and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course selection should consider genre focus—multiple genres are available, so match course content to the writer's intended form and subject matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flexible delivery formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Stanford Continuing Studies offers writing workshops and online and on-campus writing courses, so you can choose the format that best fits your schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delivery mode (online vs. in-person) is a stated program feature; select format based on scheduling, learning preferences, and desired campus experience ('Experience the Stanford campus in person or online').

rubrics_metrics.name: Open enrollment / no admission requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Open to all adults. No admission requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility is unrestricted for adults; enrollment criteria are minimal—this affects accessibility and the likely heterogeneity of classmates' skill levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engaging course experience
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program emphasizes engagement as a quality metric; look for course descriptions, instructor bios, and syllabi that demonstrate interactive, motivating class activities and sustained participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regularly refreshed curriculum
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course offerings are updated frequently; this implies opportunities for new topics, rotating electives, and continual curriculum renewal—useful when seeking topical or current-course content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ease of registration (online recommended)
rubrics_metrics.description: The fastest and easiest way to register for courses is online. You may browse through the website, add courses to your cart, and then complete the online registration process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical guidance on administrative process: prefer online registration for speed and convenience; use 'View Cart' to proceed if courses are known in advance.
